Name: Retronomics
Details: The dissolution of the Star League in 2781 brought a period of economic chaos, as specialized worlds and economies suddently found themselves out of contact from their suppliers or customers, causing hyperinflation, mass unemployment, poverty and even famine and epidemics on populations that fully depended on imported food or medicine. In order to survive, governments had to take strict regressive economic policies like tariffs, deindustrialization or forced population migration, that became later known as 'retronomics'.
